resolutionStatus.finalValue: Khan passa du cricket à la philanthropie et à la politique : capitaine des champions du monde de 1992, fondateur du PTI en 1996, Premier ministre en 2018–2022. Ses propositions anticorruption et son projet d’État-providence mobilisèrent ses partisans ; économie et rapports civils-militaires divisèrent sous son gouvernement. Emprisonné depuis 2023, il a vu des condamnations suspendues ou annulées, tandis que les appels continuent. Il nie toute faute ; le gouvernement nie des poursuites politiques.

sourceChronologyReview.scope: Read all canonical Chinese and English display fields for exactly these four profiles; directly checked selected current offices, term chronology, future appointments, nomination status, major war/legal attribution and specified milestones. Six other locales, portraits, licenses and exhaustive career/birth verification were outside scope. Read-only review: no owner content, shared code, manifest, git, build or publication edits.
sourceChronologyReview.limits: AI peer review, not independent certification, human review or continuous monitoring. Sources assessed at access date with factual cutoff preserved. Dynamic official biographies can contain stale ancillary role claims; dated primary records were preferred for current status. Specific direct-access limits are recorded under Grossi. Publication-ready labels elsewhere were not treated as factual proof.
